entry.title: Bethesda has revealed TES VI to be set in Hammerfell
entry.summary: A new detail has been revealed for long anticipated open-world rpg The Elder Scrolls 6.

entry.title: Micro Center now lists GeForce RTX 5090 cards as 'Not Carried'
entry.summary: The American computer retailer Micro Center no longer appears to be receiving new RTX 5090 graphics cards from any of their suppliers.

entry.title: GTA VI will launch at $80 USD
entry.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 will launch at $80 USD, and $100 for the ‘Ultimate Edition’.

entry.title: Valve launches the Steam Machine starting at $1049 USD.
entry.summary: Valve has officially launched the new Steam Machine. It’s a small gaming PC intended to provide a more console like, living room oriented experience. It comes preinstalled with Steam OS, the same linux-based operating system used on the Steam Deck.

entry.title: Microsoft is closing game studio Ninja Theory
entry.summary: Microsoft is shuttering the famous game studio Ninja Theory, known for having developed the Hellblade series of games. The third game in that series called ‘Senua’ was in active development at the time of this report.

entry.title: Rockstar Games employees have formed a union
entry.summary: Employees of Rockstar Games have announced their intent to form a union, to be called “Rockstar Game Workers Union”. It will be a subsidiary of the existing “Workers’ Union of Great Britain”.

entry.title: Star Citizen has reached $1 billion in funding
entry.summary: The in-development video game Star Citizen has now received over one billion dollars in funding.

entry.title: Warhorse Studios Announces a new Lord of the Rings RPG
entry.summary: The developer of Kingdom Come Deliverance has just announced that they are working on an officially licensed Lord of the Rings video game. It will be an open-world RPG.

entry.title: Pirates are already playing Forza Horizon 6 days before its launch
entry.summary: Game pirates are already playing Forza Horizon 6, more than a week ahead of the title’s official release date.

entry.title: Steam Controller to have a reservation queue
entry.summary: Starting May 8th, Valve will implement a reservation queue for the Steam Controller.

entry.title: Steam Controller released, quickly sold out
entry.summary: Valve launched its new Steam Controller on May 5th 2026, and almost instantly sold out.
